inputs.name: selenium_version
inputs.description: Tag shared by the docker.io/selenium/hub and node images, such as "4.51.0-20261010". Change the image digests with it.

inputs.name: hub_image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of docker.io/selenium/hub for selenium_version. Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: browsers
inputs.description: Browsers to run, each in a node of its own: "chromium", "firefox" or both.

inputs.name: node_max_sessions
inputs.description: Browser sessions each node runs at once. Allow about 1 GB of memory for each.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: IPv4 address the Grid listens on. The Grid has no authentication, so anyone who can reach this address can drive its browsers. Read the README before changing it.
